method: Authoring preservation audit of exact indexed baked faces: compare the previous retained planting algorithm with the new buffer-referencing index, at native tree roots, actual face interiors and edges, +/-1e-9 boundary probes and bounded dry/wet points. It does not alter a renderer, camera, game state or E2E gate. Node CPU/heap figures are a single authoring-process sample, not browser timing, retained memory or phone performance.
